$comment: Input for scripts/car-model/glb-to-parts-stl.py + stl-to-glb.mjs (see .claude/skills/rally-car-import). Source: sources/cars/skoda-rally/skoda-fabia-r5-rally-car-senturyuk.glb (CC BY 4.0, SenturyUK). The GLB is already model-aligned (+x left, +y up, +z nose, ground y 0) at true scale (its 2.475 m wheelbase is the Fabia R5's 2,470 mm) but sits at x ~ -6.86; the offset centres it and puts the front hub on physics front.z = 1.15. The atlas block is also read by livery.ts at runtime - keep them in sync by editing only here.

wheels.$comment: the wheels are separate meshes (dropped below) - nothing to cut

chartBoxes.$comment: front bumper lip (y 0.19 - 0.27, same band on the side and front charts): its top ledge took the top chart (white saw teeth along the lip) and the corner chamfer the side charts (green tips) - every body face of the lip and round the corners reads the front chart; undersides (ny < -0.5) stay on the dark bottom chart

rear bumper corner (|x| 0.55 - 1.1, y 0.15 - 0.56, z < -1.72): the corner chamfer and the fin beside the arch were split between the left / right and rear charts (ragged band edge, white chips next to the green) - every face except undersides reads the rear chart, so the band is one clean shape

rear bumper lower edge (|x| < 0.55, y 0.28 - 0.34, z -2.0 - -1.85): the 45 degree bevel under the bumper (normal y -0.7) went to the dark bottom chart and showed as black triangles between the body colour - it reads the rear chart like the rest of the bumper

gltf.$comment: primitive -> material (first matching rule wins; x / y / z boxes are in the GLB's own world coordinates, before scale / offset). Wheels_0 = 4 tyres (350k triangles) + rims, replaced by the game's physics wheels. Object_13 / Object_38 are two tiny logo decals on the dash. mat_15 (Object_40) = the model's four brake discs (4 x 92 triangles, 0.34 m across at the hubs): they fell to the default trim and showed as flat black discs next to the game's own discs + calipers.

parts.$comment: manufacturer badge reliefs (grille centre, tailgate centre) - no logos (AGENTS.md)
wing (blade, end plates, uprights) and roof scoop: carbon, picked as whole islands inside the box so the roof lip / roof next to them stay out

black screen borders (the body mesh runs right up to the glass, the real car has a black ceramic border + black A-pillars): windscreen and rear screen glass are mat_25 - the side windows are mat_25 too, so `facing` keeps only the screens' samples (their normals have |x| < 0.1, the side glass ~0.94)
A-pillars black (as the real car): the front end (model z > 0.17) of the roof-rail island (480 triangles each side) - the windscreen ring alone left them white with black teeth
rear screen ring: only above the tailgate's top edge (y 1.0), lower down the big tailgate triangles turned into black spikes
black frame round the rear screen (as the real car): roof lip under the wing, the screen frame, the fins beside it - whole islands, the C-pillar outer skin is one big island and stays body
body behind the lower bumper grille shows through its slots: black like the real car's grille backing

front bumper corner intakes (the pocket behind the bumper face, model z < 1.9; outline traced in the front view): the pocket floor and walls were body colour, the real car has black openings. An exact outline cut - a centre-based box left saw teeth along the top edge
mirror glass: the backward-facing island of each mirror head

rear bumper lower valance (below y 0.29, like the real car's black diffuser area): the model's diffuser fins intersect the bumper skin, which showed as black teeth poking through the white from below - both black now, so the intersection line disappears. Exact outline cut, rear view

windscreen header: the black border stopped ~3 cm short of the roof edge, where the model's inner windscreen layer and two small 6-triangle glass wedges at the corners showed as glass teeth - that strip of mat_25 (y > 1.27, model z 0.2 - 0.34) is black border too

headlight outer cover (the whole mat_24 island in front of model z 1.3, incl. its wrap round the outer corner - until 2026-10-04 that part was dark glass): smoked see-through, so the modelled reflector bowls show
tail lamp covers (and the third brake light's): dropped - the clear cover washed the red lens pink (env reflection + 20 % haze); the lamp shell shows directly
mat_18 = the two bonnet vent slots (y > 0.7) and the lower bumper intake panel: wire mesh
indicator bulbs: the small bulb in the outer reflector of each headlight (whole islands)
front half of mat_7 = the lamp unit: reflector bowls, bolts, bezel

tail lamp inner wall (the side towards the tailgate, model |x| 0.5 - 0.6, faces pointing at the car's centre): the lens shell's wall, the body's opening wall and the black seal lie within 1 cm of each other - the transparent lens showed through as a red wedge outside the light (z-fighting). Black like the seal

ribbon of lens faces beyond the inner edge of the white light: it lay in the black seam gap / over the body opening and showed as a pink wedge outside the light from the side. Exact straight cut (rear view, model x, y) 0.6 cm outside the white parallelogram's inner edge (x 0.563 at y 0.759 -> 0.577 at y 0.829, i.e. x = 0.569 + 0.2 (y - 0.759)) - a centre-based box left saw teeth through the white
